findings.note: Case text drift: right-click on a conversation item opens no menu. The menu opens from the hover 3-dot button (conversation-menu-menu-button). Same drift as ELITEA-3784. Not a defect.

Case step 7 lists 'Duplicate', which does not exist on DEV. The menu has 7 items: Rename, Move to, Playback, Export, Share externally, Pin on top, Delete. 'make-public' is not rendered in a private project.

Keyboard navigation is not supported. Focus stays on the menu container (a DIV with no role), ArrowDown and Tab do not move to items, and Enter does nothing. Not filed as a bug: the case says 'if supported', and this is arguably an accessibility gap.

Possible regression: navigate_to_chat() and wait_for_page_load() time out (15s wait for chat-message-input) on the blank-chat landing on DEV. The earlier run reproduced it 3x. Workaround: page.goto(f"{app_base_url}/app/chat") plus chat.dismiss_platform_banner_dialog(), then wait for the conversation item.
Playwright MCP Chrome was missing in the earlier analyst run, so it used scratch pytest. Use --reruns 0 to override the rerun addopts, because -p no:rerunfailures breaks the run.
The page object's CONVERSATION_MENU_ITEM_KEYS has 'share' but DEV renders 'share-external'. The tuple is documentation only, because get_conversation_menu_item formats any key.
Case text says right-click opens the context menu, but on DEV it opens nothing. The menu opens from the hover 3-dot button, the same drift seen in ELITEA-3784. The test uses the 3-dot button.

The case lists 'Duplicate' between Playback and Export, but DEV doesn't render it. The menu has 7 items: Rename, Move to, Playback, Export, Share externally, Pin on top, Delete. The test asserts that live order.

Keyboard navigation does not work on the menu: focus stays on the container and the items don't receive it. Steps 13-14 are conditional ('if supported') and not automated. This is arguably an accessibility gap, but no requirement backs it and it was not filed.
`CONVERSATION_MENU_ITEM_KEYS` in chat_page.py lists `share`, but DEV renders `share-external`. The tuple is documentation only, so I left it unchanged.

`automation/.env.test` is missing in this checkout, so `APP_PREFIX` defaults to `''`. Gate runs must set `APP_PREFIX=/app`, or provide the `.env.test` symlink. Otherwise every spec that uses `settings.app_base_url` lands on a 404.

The AFS said `navigate_to_chat()`/`wait_for_page_load()` time out on the blank-chat landing. The spec avoids them with `page.goto` plus `dismiss_platform_banner_dialog`. This is a possible regression in that helper and was not investigated here.
